notes.title: Steam Neo Fest Broadcast
notes.content:
Hello!

For this latest stream, we're going to show you what a 4-person game of [u]Sneaky Seekers[/u] looks like. Follow our [b]4 players[/b] as they try out all the game modes and modifiers available in the demo! 

If you have any questions, the developers will be available in the chat! 

See you soon!

notes.title: Sneaky Seekers - Chat with the Devs
notes.content:
Today we're celebrating the [b]Steam Neo fest[/b]! Come and join us in a stream to chat with us for 1h30 and learn more about our game. 

Sneaky Seekers is a local party game for 2 to 4 players. You play as little lamps whose mission is to find a treasure hidden in the map and escape with it! 

The demo includes 3 game modes, a Medley mode and 4 modifiers to spice up the game! To find out more, check out our steam page.

The stream starts at [b]12 p.m. EST[/b]! See you there!

See you then!
Lavascript Studio

notes.title: New demo online
notes.content:
[b]Hello there![/b]

After careful consideration, we've decided to rework the gameplay to make it more fun and easier to learn. Here's a list of the changes you'll find:

[b]Mini-games with different worlds but more similar objectives:[/b] We've made the mini-games simpler. The goal in each level will still be to find a treasure (a gold nugget, an idol, etc.) hidden in a destructible container (a haunted statue, a rock, a shipwreck), and finally escape through the exit with the loot. However, the levels are distinguished by the enemies you can find! So be careful and don't forget to hide from them!

[b]Modifiers:[/b] Once you've mastered the vanilla versions of the various mini-games, change the way you play completely with the modifiers! The demo contains the game's first 4 modifiers, each offering a different gameplay experience, for more replayability and chaos!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44196984/2948f3eba7285a65bd2c782c0abe36134f3158ad.png[/img]

[b]Skins:[/b] 4 new lamp skins are available in the demo in addition to the 4 basic skins, a little taste of what you'll find in the full version of the game.

[b]The Medley:[/b] Have you played all the mini-games in the demo? Then you're ready for Medley mode, which will play different levels from all the mini-games, plus random modifiers to make each level totally different from the last!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44196984/a91820aa21ac1351c4494c8d936cbe633b83b474.png[/img]

[b]Keyboard/Mouse:[/b] One of your friends doesn't have a controller? We've added keyboard/mouse support. Please note, however, that this is only available to one player, so the others will need a controller to play.

[b]Thanks for reading! Don't hesitate to join our discord or post a message on Steam if you have any questions. [/b]
